text:
alex_s: Quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC — want to align on rollback safeties for per-model fallbacks.

maya_p: +1. We saw two incidents where fallback kernels were accidentally disabled during canary, causing increased latency.

ben_k: Link to the incident summary: https://internal/it/incident/789

sophie_t: TL;DR? What broke exactly?

maya_p: runtime routed to quantized-kernel-v2, cache hot paths worked, but fallback to fp16-kernel was gated by a feature flag that got flipped in one rollout step. No graceful fallback.

alex_s: Proposed guardrails:
- safe-default per-model: always have an unconditional fallback kernel set in model metadata
- rollout override protection: require an explicit "allow-fallback-disable" flag for dev builds only
- telemetry alert: new alert on >1% fallback_failures in 5m

ben_k: Can we express that in our rollout config? I sketched something:

```
rollout_policy:
  model_selector: "gpt-small*"
  stages:
    - pct: 5
      kernel: quantized-v2
      allow_disable_fallback: false
    - pct: 50
      kernel: quantized-v2
      allow_disable_fallback: false
  fallback_kernels:
    - fp16-v1
    - cpu-safe
```

sophie_t: Also add an automatic rollback if fallback_failures spike after stage bump.

alex_s: yes — action: add `auto_rollback_on_fallback_failure: 1%` to policy and a circuit-breaker that pauses the rollout.

ben_k: Implementation notes: runtime needs to reject config updates that remove `fallback_kernels` unless `force=true` and logged with an audit event.

maya_p: We should also prevent UI-based quick toggles for production flags. Only infra-admins via infra-cli can flip `allow_disable_fallback` in prod.

sophie_t: +1. I'll add RBAC to the console for that flag.

deploy-bot: new config push by ben_k at 1965432400: rollout_policy/gpt-small applied to canary

ben_k: I'll open a short follow-up RFC with the required schema changes and roll out plan.

alex_s: Action items:
- ben_k: RFC + schema PR (due EOD Thu)
- sophie_t: Console RBAC change (due next week)
- maya_p: Add telemetry alert + dashboard (due Fri)
- alex_s: Add tests to runtime to block fallback-kernel removal (due Mon)

maya_p: anything else?

alex_s: Nothing else. Thanks all :thumbsup:
